summary: Connect digital policies to legal obligations, control owners, and evidence. Explore the five-day course outline and see if it fits your role.
lede: Digital governance and law training helps professionals connect digital obligations with accountable operating controls. It is for digital governance officers, legal advisers, and compliance specialists who need to assess policy gaps and show how responsibilities and evidence support decisions; participants map privacy and cybersecurity duties, document AI oversight, and examine electronic transaction records and digital content rights before bringing findings together in a governance report.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, review, or evidence digital policies and legal controls across technology-enabled services.
modules: OECD AI Principles and Governance Mandates
Digital Legal Exposure and NIST CSF 2.0
prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational policies, digital services, or compliance and risk processes is recommended. No legal qualification or programming experience is required.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
